detailed_descriptions_html.en:
★Story★

An Ogre infiltrating the Ninja Village!? Exploration RPG! No combat element!

Mesmerized by the Ninja who destroyed its hometown!

The story of the Ogre's revenge!

★Game Features★

[Gameplay]

Sneak through the ninja village, avoid enemy lines of sight, and strike from blind spots to defeat opponents. Success depends on reading enemy patrol patterns, using the environment, and choosing the right moment to act.

[Stealth & Strategy]

Enemies remain alert and constantly train throughout the village. Getting spotted can quickly put you at a disadvantage, encouraging players to plan routes carefully and eliminate threats one by one.

★Other★

・Estimated Playing Time: About an hour.
・This game is made with RPG Maker
・The system requirements, startup methods, and operation methods are all based on RPG Maker.
